provenance: Cold review of the ADR-034 resolver, 2026-08-24 (the era-gate finding). reac-2015 is a 2015 filing with NO Section 12(b) column ('Securities registered pursuant to Section 12 (b) of the Act - None'), so ADR-034 §c requires `not_in_era`. But its cover carries the market-value sentence '...held by non-affiliates and NO TRADING SYMBOL.', and the gate was a bare substring search for `trading\s+symbol`, which the negation satisfies. MEASURED RED: trading_symbol resolved to 'K' at 0.95 -- the first \b[A-Z]{1,5}\b token after that sentence, which is the K of 'Form 10-K'. This is the failure the §g mutation table could not see: deleting the era gate proved it fires on covers that never say the words, and said nothing about a cover that says them in prose. `not_in_era` is called a POSITIVE CLAIM by §c, and a positive claim that a negation can flip was not being tested.
